observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor dirt clearing with a low hill and open sky in the background, daytime
observation.dancers: large group of mixed young men and women
observation.formation_and_space: semi-circle formation facing inward and moving slightly in place or shifting positions
observation.posture: upright torso with knees slightly bent and bouncing, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: rhythmic stepping and stamping on the spot matching the musical beat, shifting weight side to side
observation.arms_and_hands: holding long wooden sticks or horns upright in one hand, often raised high or moved in coordination with the beat
observation.hips_and_torso: bouncing and swaying of the hips and torso corresponding to the knee bends and stepping
observation.levels_jumps_turns: low level bouncing, occasional small hops, no extensive jumps or floor work, slight turning transitions
observation.costume_and_props: women wear layered ruffled skirts in black, yellow, red, and blue with matching t-shirts; men wear traditional tunics, patterned wrappers, or leaf adornments; holding long wooden sticks/horns
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement details obscured by skirts and ground dust

signature_moments.what: dancers in semi-circle stepping rhythmically with bent knees while holding sticks upright
dancers shifting position while maintaining the bounce step and upright stick hold
